title: Coaching day
description: One day's plan, as its own document. Promotes the `structuredDay` shape out of a decision's `nextThreeDays` so that revising one day cannot overwrite another. The reasoning behind a day — mode, debt, tracker snapshot, provenance — stays in the assessment named by `authoredBy`, and is never repeated here.

dayVersion.description: Day-document format version. Unrelated to the decision document's `version` or `outlookSchemaVersion`.

authoredBy.description: The coaching run that wrote this day. Comparing these across days is how drift is detected: a day whose dependency was authored by a LATER assessment than itself was reasoned against a version that no longer exists, and must be revised before it can be trusted.

assessment.description: Assessment id, which is its `assessedAt` stripped of punctuation. Sorts chronologically.

dependencies.description: Measurements this day waits on. A dependency names a grade — slug, local date and practice mode — not another day's file, so it resolves from the practice log alone.

unresolved.description: Shown while a required result is still unknown.
